notes: The extension now checks its own work. After saving each report it reads the file back and makes sure it actually has something in it. Before this, a report was marked done simply because saving raised no error - so a file could land with the right name in the right folder and nothing inside, and you would only find out when you opened it.
If that ever happens you now get a clear message naming the report, and the empty file is left where it is rather than quietly deleted.
